title: Distinguish separate metabolic flux extrema
prompt: A metabolic flux variability analysis finds a maximum of 10 for reaction A and 10 for reaction B, each optimized separately. Can both maxima be reported as one feasible state or as measured intracellular rates? Explain what is needed. Do not edit files.
rubric: The response states that separately optimized extrema need not coexist in one feasible solution.
It distinguishes constraint-based model predictions from measured intracellular fluxes.
It asks for a joint feasibility check and reports relevant model assumptions.
acceptance: The response does not present separate maxima as one measured or jointly feasible state without evidence.
